messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that generates procedural top-down FPS maps.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Generates procedural FPS maps with rooms, corridors, spawn points, weapon pickups
- Color scheme: black walls, gray floors, green spawn points, red weapon pickups
- Maps must be tactically interesting and playable (not random noise)
- Include minimap legend and "Generate New Map" button
- Flood-fill algorithm ensures all areas are reachable
- Smooth performance targeting 60 FPS during generation
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function generateMap(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const tileSize=10;const size=50;let map=Array.from({length:size},()=>Array(size).fill(0));for(let i=0;i<size;i++){map[0][i]=0;map[size-1][i]=0;map[i][0]=0;map[i][size-1]=0;}const rooms=[];const roomCount=Math.floor(Math.random()*4)+5;for(let i=0;i<roomCount;i++){const w=Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+5;const h=Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+5;const x=Math.floor(Math.random()*(size-2-w))+1;const y=Math.floor(Math.random()*(size-2-h))+1;for(let r=x;r<x+w;r++){for(let c=y;c<y+h;c++){map[r][c]=1;}}rooms.push({x:Math.floor(x+w/2),y:Math.floor(y+h/2)});}for(let i=0;i<rooms.length-1;i++){const a=rooms[i];const b=rooms[i+1];let cx=a.x,cy=a.y;while(cx!==b.x){map[cx][cy]=1;cx+=b.x>cx?1:-1;}while(cy!==b.y){map[cx][cy]=1;cy+=b.y>cy?1:-1;}}function flood(){const visited=Array.from({length:size},()=>Array(size).fill(false));let start=null;for(let i=0;i<size&&!start;i++){for(let j=0;j<size&& !start;j++){if(map[i][j]===1){start=[i,j];}}}if(!start)return{reachable:false,visited};const queue=[start];let head=0;visited[start[0]][start[1]]=true;let count=0;while(head<queue.length){const [x,y]=queue[head++];if(map[x][y]!==1)continue;count++;if(x>0&&!visited[x-1][y]){visited[x-1][y]=true;queue.push([x-1,y]);}if(x<size-1&&!visited[x+1][y]){visited[x+1][y]=true;queue.push([x+1,y]);}if(y>0&&!visited[x][y-1]){visited[x][y-1]=true;queue.push([x,y-1]);}if(y<size-1&&!visited[x][y+1]){visited[x][y+1]=true;queue.push([x,y+1]);}}const totalFloor=map.flat().filter(v=>v===1).length;return{reachable:count===totalFloor,visited};}let floodResult=flood();while(!floodResult.reachable){map=Array.from({length:size},()=>Array(size).fill(0));for(let i=0;i<size;i++){map[0][i]=0;map[size-1][i]=0;map[i][0]=0;map[i][size-1]=0;}}const visited=floodResult.visited;const floorSites=[];for(let i=0;i<size;i++){for(let j=0;j<size;j++){if(map[i][j]===1&&visited[i][j])floorSites.push([i,j]);}}let spawnPoints=[];if(floorSites.length>=2){const first=floorSites[Math.floor(Math.random()*floorSites.length)];spawnPoints.push(first);let far=first,maxD=-1;for(const [x,y] of floorSites){const d=Math.abs(x-first[0])+Math.abs(y-first[1]);if(d>maxD){maxD=d;far=[x,y];}}spawnPoints.push(far);}const pickCount=Math.floor(Math.random()*3)+3;const pickups=[];const available=floorSites.filter(([x,y])=>!spawnPoints.some(sp=>sp[0]===x&&sp[1]===y));for(let i=0;i<pickCount&&available.length;i++){const idx=Math.floor(Math.random()*available.length);pickups.push(available[idx]);available.splice(idx,1);}}ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);for(let i=0;i<size;i++){for(let j=0;j<size;j++){ctx.fillStyle=map[i][j]===1?'gray':'black';ctx.fillRect(i*tileSize,j*tileSize,tileSize,tileSize);}}ctx.fillStyle='green';for(const [x,y] of spawnPoints){ctx.fillRect(x*tileSize,y*tileSize,tileSize,tileSize);}ctx.fillStyle='red';for(const [x,y] of pickups){ctx.fillRect(x*tileSize,y*tileSize,tileSize,tileSize);}const legendX=10,legendY=10;const legendBg='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';ctx.fillStyle=legendBg;ctx.fillRect(legendX-2,legendY-2,120,80);ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.font='12px Arial';ctx.fillText('Legend',legendX,legendY+12);const entries=[['Walls','black'],['Floor','gray'],['Spawn','green'],['Weapon','red']];let line=legendY+25;for(const [label,color] of entries){ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(legendX,line,15,15);ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.fillText(label,legendX+20,line+12);line+=20;}let btn=document.getElementById('generateBtn');if(!btn){btn=document.createElement('button');btn.id='generateBtn';btn.innerText='Generate New Map';btn.style.position='absolute';btn.style.top=(canvas.offsetTop+canvas.height+10)+'px';btn.style.left=canvas.offsetLeft+'px';document.body.appendChild(btn);btn.onclick=()=>generateMap(canvasId);}}
